set -euo pipefail; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
for p in [Path('/tmp/kobra-curve-job'), Path('/tmp/kobra-text-job')]:
    report=json.loads((p/'report.json').read_text())
    assert report['safety']['valid'] is True
    assert report['execution']['allowed'] is False
    b=report['geometry']['output_bounds']
    assert 3 <= b['min_x'] <= b['max_x'] <= 223
    assert 36 <= b['min_y'] <= b['max_y'] <= 230
    g=(p/'output.gcode').read_text()
    for token in ['G28','G91','M104','M109','M140','M190',' E']:
        assert token not in g, (p, token)
    allowed={'G90','G0','G1','M400'}
    for raw in g.splitlines():
        code=raw.split(';',1)[0].strip()
        if code:
            assert code.split()[0] in allowed, code
    print(p.name, report['geometry']['polylines'], report['geometry']['points'], report['geometry']['output_bounds'], report['geometry']['nominal_time_seconds'])
PY
